title: A Good Soldier of Christ Jesus, A Worker Approved by God

questions.question: You then, my child, be ____ by the grace that is in Christ Jesus,
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:1 (ESV): "You then, my child, be strengthened by the grace that is in Christ Jesus,"

questions.question: and what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses entrust to ____ men, who will be able to teach others also.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:2 (ESV): "and what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses entrust to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also."

questions.question: Share in suffering as a good ____ of Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:3 (ESV): "Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus."

questions.question: No soldier gets entangled in civilian pursuits, since his aim is to please the one who ____ him.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:4 (ESV): "No soldier gets entangled in civilian pursuits, since his aim is to please the one who enlisted him."

questions.question: An athlete is not crowned unless he competes according to the ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:5 (ESV): "An athlete is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules."

questions.question: It is the hard-working ____ who ought to have the first share of the crops.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:6 (ESV): "It is the hard-working farmer who ought to have the first share of the crops."

questions.question: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, the offspring of ____, as preached in my gospel,
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:8 (ESV): "Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, the offspring of David, as preached in my gospel,"

questions.question: For which Paul is suffering, bound with chains as a criminal. But the word of God is not ____!
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:9 (ESV): "for which I am suffering, bound with chains as a criminal. But the word of God is not bound!"

questions.question: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the ____, that they also may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:10 (ESV): "Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they also may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory."

questions.question: The saying is trustworthy, for: If we have died with him, we will also ____ with him;
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:11 (ESV): "The saying is trustworthy, for: If we have died with him, we will also live with him;"

questions.question: if we endure, we will also ____ with him; if we deny him, he also will deny us;
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:12 (ESV): "if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he also will deny us;"

questions.question: if we are faithless, he remains ____—for he cannot deny himself.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:13 (ESV): "if we are faithless, he remains faithful—for he cannot deny himself."

questions.question: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:15 (ESV): "Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth."

questions.question: But God's firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: "The Lord knows those who are ____,"
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:19 (ESV): "But God's firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: 'The Lord knows those who are his,' and, 'Let everyone who names the name of the Lord depart from iniquity.'"

questions.question: So flee ____ passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace...
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 2:22 (ESV): "So flee youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart."

key_verse_text: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.
